What’s the opportunity?

We seek an experienced and dynamic FX Sales Manager to drive business growth and manage relationships with key clients in the money remittance and financial services sectors. In this role, you will lead FX negotiations, collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions and ensure exceptional execution of cross-border payment transactions. You will leverage your expertise in FX markets to provide valuable insights to clients while consistently meeting sales targets and contributing to the organization’s overall success.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive negotiations with existing money remittance and financial services merchants, ensuring the achievement of sales targets while optimizing client value.
  • Build and maintain long-lasting relationships with clients by understanding their specific needs and delivering tailored FX solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Work closely with the internal Trader team to ensure alignment on market strategies, competitive pricing, and efficient execution of FX transactions.
  • Provide clients with actionable insights on FX market trends, movements, and forecasts, helping them stay informed and make sound decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of FX transactions, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and operational excellence.
  • Regularly conduct market analysis and research on industry trends and competitors to stay ahead of market developments and anticipate client needs.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What skills do I need?

  • Strong knowledge of local and international FX markets, including market dynamics, trading strategies, and regulatory environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets, with a track record of driving revenue growth and expanding business opportunities.
  • Exceptional business development, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with experience managing high-value client accounts.
  • In-depth understanding or experience with cross-border payment systems and their complexities, including risk management and cost optimization.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a logical problem-solving approach, helping identify opportunities and overcome challenges.
  • Highly self-motivated and goal-driven, with the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage , Linkedin , Instagram , and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users.   • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.

  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.

Why Binance

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

About The Role We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you\'ll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience. Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client\'s retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We\'re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Benefits

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Realizar o monitoramento do funcionamento do sistema respiratório do paciente através da função ventilatória.

Reavaliar o plano de tratamento dos pacientes avaliando e determinando o plano terapêutico e a conduta para definir o número de sessões e tempo de tratamento.

Elaborar apresentações e descrição de processos, contribuindo para os controles internos, padronizações de atendimento, estudos direcionados, treinamentos, POPs, manuais e protocolos.

title: Manager - Route Acquisition
description:
Overview

At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact?

As the Manager - Out of Territory (OOT) Route Acquisition , you will be responsible for managing TDS associates and consultants who plan, coordinate, and supervise Colocation and Joint Use activities across multiple locations and states. The role requires close collaboration with representatives from field services, associate managers, consultants, Outside Plant engineers, COLO/ROW team members, third-party consultants, and construction/engineering contractors supporting both TDS CLEC and ILEC operations to ensure company needs are effectively met.

In this role you will oversee Colocation and Joint Use activities for TDS Telecom fiber networks, ensuring compliance with existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP standards. This position supervises colocation team members managing OOT and CLEC/ILEC projects throughout the entire TDS footprint.

Key responsibilities include monitoring costs, maintaining and generating reports, enforcing adherence to TDS standards and practices, developing workflows and protocols as needed, and tracking overall job progress to ensure construction projects are completed on time and within budget. You will actively drive TDS initiatives at both the team and organizational levels.

Additionally, you will set goals and expectations while fostering a positive work environment that supports coaching and mentoring team members to achieve those goals. In this role you will also proactively identify opportunities to enhance the skills of each team member, contributing to the ongoing development and elevated performance of the entire team.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the management of TDS associates and/or consultants who are responsible for planning, coordinating and supervising Out of Territory Route Acquisition activities in multiple locations and states. The person filling this position is expected to work closely with representatives from field services, associate managers, Outside Plant Engineers, OSPC team members, 3rd party consultants and construction/engineering contractors for TDS Out of Territory (OOT) operations to ensure that the needs of the company are being met.
  • The incumbent will be responsible for the OOT Route Acquisition activities of TDS Telecom fiber networks while conforming to existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP. The incumbent will be responsible for continually working with various permitting entities, contractors, and agencies when/where applicable. Negotiation, coordination, and cooperation skills to expedite permitting/workflow crucial to this role.
  • Verify all permitting documentation to gain approved access for OSP construction activities (R/W, Easements, PUE, etc) is accurate, complete and clear. The incumbent will seek to drive consistency and clarity of all protocols to expedite permit approval process.
  • Verify that all documentation required to complete projects successfully, including Bid Jobs, build orders, Job Start Agreements, RFP, legal agreements, permitting agreements and close-out documentation is complete.
  • Review all required reports from OOT Route Acquisition team and contractor invoicing for accuracy. Role will track and process PO’s, Check Requests, CLARITY, etc to drive accuracy for reporting internally to TDS finance department.
  • The incumbent will use strong OSP & Route acquisition background to assist in troubleshooting escalated issues when necessary to achieve expedited results with permitting entities or internal teams.
  • Provides human resource management and manpower apportionment necessary for completion of network projects. This includes managing in-house deployment staff as well as engaging and managing professional consultant engineers during peak periods. Focus is on personnel development through performance assessments, coaching, recognition, and process improvement.
  • Conduct periodic quality assurance inspection of OSP projects performed by Local Operations personnel.
  • Manage specific projects OSP projects directly if schedule permits
  • Design projects and prepare OSP workplans for construction or modification of network facilities if schedule permits. Including confirm and analyze OTDR trace results to verify contractor splicing quality.
  • Assist in the training of field personnel on standards, RUS and TDS practices, time reporting codes and report/form preparation.
  • Provide recommendations to management for improving standards and practices resulting in higher quality and lower cost projects.
  • Assist Network Operations staff in developing Capital Additions, Budget assumptions and long-range planning.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree (or higher) -OR- 4+ years professional work experience.
  • 5+ years\' experience in telephony or related fields.
  • 3+ years\' supervisory experience
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver\'s license.

Other Qualifications:

  • Excellent leadership, project management, customer relations and communications skills
  • Thorough Understanding of Telecommunications industry and principals.
  • Deep understanding of CLARITY/PM style programs and creating analytic reports.
  • Thorough understanding of financial tracking and budgetary reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Understanding of Colocation/Joint use process.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills.
  • Outlook, Excel and Office suite as well as GIS and ESRi.
  • Working knowledge of RUS construction practices and engineering standards.
  • Ability to work in a cooperative and courteous manner with diverse work groups.
  • Must be self-motivated and self-reliant.
  • May be required to regular travel on an "as-needed" basis.

Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today!

Benefits

We believe in taking care of our team, which is why we offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, financial well-being, and overall happiness. Join us and experience a work environment where your well-being is a top priority!

Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to:

  • Medical Coverage
  • Dental Coverage
  • Vision Coverage
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Generous Vacation & Paid Sick Leave
  • Seven Paid National Holidays & One Floating Holiday
  • Paid Parental Leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment)
  • Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance
  • Employee Assistance & Wellness Programs

Associates working 30 or more hours per week additionally have access to:

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • TDS Service Discounts
  • Education Assistance
  • Paid Volunteer Time

In addition to these benefits, all associates will have the opportunity to participate in our Associate Resource Groups, which are designed to encourage community and facilitate professional development. To learn more, click here.

Who is TDS Telecom?

TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Serving over 1 million connections, our mission is to create a better world by delivering innovative communication solutions that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Visittdstelecom.com to learn more!

Job description

O Colecta by eSales é uma solução inovadora que otimiza a gestão de dados na cadeia de distribuição, capturando e comparando informações de estoque e vendas para melhorar a produção, o controle de estoque e a programação de vendas. Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolvimento de Funcionalidades: Implementar e manter funcionalidades no Colecta, criando soluções escaláveis que atendam às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência Técnica: Proficiência em React (hooks, Context API) e Node.js, com conhecimento sólido em PostgreSQL e APIs RESTful.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Experiência com autenticação (OAuth, JWT) e integração de APIs.
  • Soft Skills: Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, proatividade e foco em resultados.

Programa de acolhimento psicológico.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

  • The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of data analysis, reporting, and visualization, as well as the ability to effectively communicate insights to clients. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining reports that directly impact client business performance, conducting deep dive analyses, and translating complex data into actionable insights. You will work directly with marketing tools and platforms to access campaign data, build compelling presentations, and identify optimization opportunities across multiple channels.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain automated reports for eComm, B2B, and B2C with performance metrics across all marketing channels based on client needs and our recommendations
  • Access and analyze data directly from marketing platforms (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.) to identify meaningful performance insights
  • Create and update weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance decks with a focus on data storytelling and actionable recommendations
  • Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover optimization opportunities and answer specific business questions
  • Transform complex data into clear, concise visualizations that effectively communicate performance to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Utilize Google Sheets and other tools for sophisticated data manipulation and analysis
  • Simplify and present findings eloquently with a focus on connecting data to business outcomes
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance reporting capabilities and generate deeper insights
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem to enhance reporting capabilities

Role Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics or digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, campaign structures, and customer journey
  • Familiarity with major digital marketing platforms (Meta, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.)
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills for data manipulation and analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, or Google Data Studio
  • Understanding of statistical concepts like regression modeling, test/control analysis, etc.
  • Experience creating performance presentations and conveying data narratives
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Self-motivated and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Task Delivery Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed on or before delivery date
  • Task Accuracy Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed successfully on initial delivery (tasks not re-opened for inaccuracies or missed requirements)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Data Storytelling and Insight Generation: Transform raw data into meaningful narratives that highlight key performance indicators, trends, and actionable recommendations. Connect marketing metrics to business outcomes in a way that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Marketing Channel Expertise: Maintain deep understanding of digital marketing platforms, metrics, and campaign structures. Stay current with platform changes and be able to contextualize performance data within the broader marketing strategy.
  • Client Communication and Reporting Excellence: Develop clear, visually appealing reports and presentations that effectively communicate performance insights. Proactively identify opportunities, address client questions, and maintain regular communication regarding deliverables and timelines.
  • Continuous Improvement of Reporting Systems: Constantly seek ways to enhance reporting templates, dashboards, and analysis methodologies. Streamline reporting processes, improve visualization techniques, and incorporate new metrics to provide more comprehensive performance insights.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. The Opportunity

title: Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Overview

Here at Shippo, we are the shipping layer of the internet and we consider ourselves to be one of the core building blocks of e-commerce. Our mission is to make merchants successful through world class shipping. With our products and solutions, we level the playing field by providing our customers with best-in-class solutions that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them. Through Shippo, e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, platforms and a variety of logistics infrastructure providers are able to connect to shipping carriers around the world from one API and dashboard. We provide our customers with the most competitive shipping rates, print labels, automated international documents, shipment tracking, facilitate the returns process and more.

We’re hiring an Analyst, Business Operations (L3) to be a high-energy generalist who thrives in spreadsheets, turns messy data into clear insights, and helps operationalize projects that move revenue and customer outcomes. You’ll start by supporting high-priority carrier operations work (e.g., data pulls, analyses to reduce billing variances), then expand into strategic analyses and GTM process improvements, especially within our platform partner ecosystem. This is an excellent role for an early-career analyst who loves data, is curious, communicates clearly, and wants broad cross-functional exposure.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

  • First 90 days: get in, get oriented, ship value
  • Own fast, accurate Google Sheets analyses and reports for carrier ops asks (think: data pulls, pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, basic modeling).
  • Partner with Carrier Ops, Partnerships, Finance, and Data to triage and quantify billing variances; share your findings
  • Document your work (inputs, queries/logic, outputs) and keep stakeholders updated with crisp async comms.
  • Start learning to read SQL queries/Databricks notebooks (no pressure to write complex SQL yet).
  • Months 3–12: broaden scope, own problems
  • Drive structured analyses to support our XMS strategy (e.g., partner pipeline sizing, revenue/label volume opportunity, cohort and conversion, playbook experiments).
  • Build lightweight dashboards/trackers (Sheets/Looker) that the team can trust and reuse.
  • Help operationalize GTM projects: draft SOPs/playbooks/templates, coordinate cross-functional tasks, and close the loop with clear follow-ups.
  • Propose small process improvements that remove toil, tighten data hygiene, or improve reporting quality.

Do you tick the boxes?

  • Must haves:
  • 1 - 3 years in an analytical role (consulting, biz ops, finance/FP&A, rev ops, product analytics, or similar).
  • Google Sheets power user: pivots, lookups, array formulas, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, filters, cleaning/joining, fast navigation.
  • Evidence of basic financial/analytical modeling and business case writing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: you ask clarifying questions, state assumptions, and keep partners in the loop. You’re not afraid to ask the ‘dumb questions’
  • Comfortable context switching and working cross-functionally in a remote environment.
  • Nice-to-haves:
  • SQL comfort (reading/editing simple SELECT/JOIN/WHERE) and curiosity to learn more; exposure to Databricks/Looker helpful.
  • Experience building simple GTM SOPs/playbooks or standing up lightweight reporting.
  • E-commerce/logistics familiarity is optional - no prior carrier background required.

What's in the Shippo package?

  • Medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage for you and your dependents. Pets coverage is also available!
  • Flexible policy for PTO and work arrangement
  • Two 1-week company shutdowns to rest and recharge (summer and winter)
  • 3 VTO days for ShippoCares volunteering events
  • Charity donation match up to $100
  • Fun team events outside of work hours - happy hours, “escape room” adventures, hikes, and more!

Sail through the process

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Remote.com (all Shippo perks still apply - including equity!). What we want to emphasize is that you can be successful at Shippo regardless of location.

We leverage AI to review all resumes during the application phase to ensure fairness, comprehensively evaluate each submission, and mitigate bias. However, all decisions at every stage of the process are made by a real person.

Highgate is a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company widely recognized as an innovator in the industry. Highgate is the dominant player in U.S. gateway markets including New York, Boston, Miami, San Francisco and Honolulu, with a rapidly expanding presence in Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Highgate’s portfolio of global properties represents an aggregate asset value exceeding $20B and generates over $5B in cumulative revenues. The company provides expert guidance through all stages of the hospitality property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate also has the creativity and bandwidth to develop bespoke hotel brands and utilizes industry-leading proprietary revenue management tools that identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive out performance and maximize asset value. With an executive team consisting of some of the industry’s most experienced hotel management leaders, the company is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. Highgate maintains corporate offices in London, New York, Dallas, and Seattle.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues.The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short-term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share.This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. One will combine this with catering and space utilization as well as other revenue considerations (i.e.: golf, spa, etc.) in order to determine the appropriate mix of business to achieve revenue potentials every day of every year.

Responsibilities
  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
  • Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
  • Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
  • Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
  • Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
  • Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
  • Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
  • Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
  • Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
  • Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
  • Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
  • Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
  • Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
  • Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
  • Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
  • Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
  • Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
  • Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
  • Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
  • Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.
Qualifications
  • At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Hotel or Hospitality Management or closely related field
  • In-Depth knowledge of all industry reports such as STR, Hotelligence, Market Vision, etc.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point
  • Ability to work quickly in a high-pressure & high stress environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Exceptional with details and follow up
  • Flexible and long hours sometimes required.
  • Maintain a warm and friendly demeanor at all times.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate both verbally and written, with all level of employees and guests in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns raised by employees and guests.
  • Must be able to multitask and prioritize departmental functions to meet deadlines.
  • Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
  • Attend all hotel required meetings and trainings.
  • Participate in M.O.D. coverage as required.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Highgate Hotel Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing nametags.

  • Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in implementing solutions.

description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Compensation set based on agreed hours / scope of part-time role (flexible). Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and strategic restraint.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; strong references at your fingertips.
  • Bold when needed, able to defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, and easy to work with. Low-ego and crisp communicator.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor (power user); Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results. Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks. Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, landing pages, campaign sets, brand work).

  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Profissional Product Owner Sênior - Remoto
description:
Overview

  • Evoluir em um ambiente de alta performance: Uma cultura onde o desenvolvimento é contínuo, com autonomia e envolvimento em projetos nacionais e internacionais que realmente testam suas habilidades e impulsionam seu potencial.
  • Integrar um time apaixonado por tecnologia: Aqui, você vai trabalhar ao lado de talentos experientes em um ambiente colaborativo e disruptivo, utilizando as tecnologias mais avançadas do mercado.
  • Deixar sua marca no mundo: Nossas soluções digitais impactam diretamente a vida de milhares de pessoas, e é a sua chance de ser parte ativa na construção de um futuro mais digital e conectado.
  • Trabalhar de forma remota e com flexibilidade: Seja qual for o seu lugar, estamos prontos para te receber no nosso time!

Sua Missão

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner nível Sênior, com forte senso de responsabilidade, organização e resiliência. Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar projetos simultaneamente, conduzindo cerimônias ágeis, garantindo alinhamento com stakeholders e liderando a transformação de escopos complexos em entregas claras para o time de desenvolvimento. Atuará sendo peça-chave na comunicação, acompanhamento e execução de entregas críticas.

Principais Atividades

  • Definir a visão do produto e a estratégia de forma clara, comunicando-a eficazmente a todas as partes interessadas.
  • Criar, priorizar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, garantindo que as histórias de usuário e os requisitos estejam alinhados com os objetivos de negócio.
  • Liderar cerimônias Agile-Scrum, incluindo planejamento de sprints, revisões e retrospectivas.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de engenharia, design e marketing para garantir a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade.
  • Coletar e analisar feedback de usuários, dados de mercado e insights da concorrência para informar as decisões de produto.
  • Identificar e documentar requisitos detalhados do produto, incluindo histórias de usuário, critérios de aceitação e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do mercado e tecnologias emergentes para identificar novas oportunidades de produto.

Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência profissional: Mais de 5 anos de experiência como Product Owner (PO) ou em uma função similar, gerenciando o ciclo de vida completo de produtos.
  • Metodologia Ágil: Forte proficiência em metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban.
  • Gestão de backlog: Habilidade comprovada em gerenciar e priorizar backlogs de produtos complexos.
  • Forte capacidade de análise de dados para tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.
  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia, Administração ou área relacionada (ou experiência equivalente).

Soft Skills Essenciais

  • Comunicação: Excelentes capacidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês.
  • Trabalho em equipe: Capacidade de trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e comunicar-se eficazmente a todos os níveis da empresa.
  • Autonomia: Ser auto-motivado, com capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e remota.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Forte capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas

Será um diferencial

  • Certificação Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) ou similar.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de produto como Jira, Trello.

O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho Remoto: Desfrute da flexibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil, com total autonomia e organização.
  • Saúde e Bem estar: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Seguro de Vida e Wellhub (Gympass).
  • +Educação: Descontos em cursos da FIAP e MBA USP Esalq para você continuar aprendendo e se desenvolvendo.
  • Diferenciais exclusivos: Descontos em lojas Multilaser, bonificação por indicação de profissionais e negócios, horário adaptável e bônus anual.

title: Associate Investigator
description:
Chainalysis Investigators are world-class problem solvers adept at covert analysis and conducting complex investigations. Our team combines technical knowledge with tenacity and intuition. We help our customers with thorny and complex investigations and along the way, make the world a safer place.

As an Investigator, you are equally adept at proactively conducting research, employing data analysis, writing, and presenting your investigative findings to team members and customers alike. You are comfortable evangelizing the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains, and are an expert at using our tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto and its impact on our customers. Collaborating with team members and across Chainalysis, you will help support the most complex financial crime investigations to meet and exceed customer requirements.

In the LATAM and the Caribbean region, you will have an unique opportunity to impact how cryptocurrency crime is investigated. You will work hand in hand with public and private sector customers in order to build capacity and enable them in the exciting and challenging world of blockchain analysis and cryptocurrency investigations.

  • In this role, you'll:

    • Collaborate with team members and across Chainalysis to support complex cryptocurrency investigations

    • Provide investigative/analytic support for extremely complex, technical, and highly sensitive investigations and initiatives pertaining to financial crimes, including cryptocurrencies

    • Conduct research and data analysis, author reports of your investigative findings, and present those findings to team members and customers

    • Review the adequacy and completeness of investigations and the data collection methods to determine the authenticity, veracity, and pertinence of that data resulting in more thorough investigations or analytic assessments.

    • Prepare in-depth summaries of data from extensive research and analysis to set forth recommendations for investigations, lead follow up, and potential risks that could hamper an investigation

    • Evangelize the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains, becoming an expert at using our tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto and its impact on our customers.

    • Develop, update and present workshops and training materials in the region's languages: English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese

    We're looking for candidates who have:

    • A degree in cybersecurity, cyber crime, intelligence, criminal justice, forensic accounting, data analytics, or a similar

    • Previous work experience conducting complex financial crime investigations for federal government, intelligence analysis or law enforcement investigations, financial services or cryptocurrency companies, or equivalent forensic experience related to dark web, counter-terrorism, or technical analysis highly desired

    • Experience conducting open-source research utilizing public and private databases highly desired

    • Interest in and/or passion for blockchain/cryptocurrency technology

    • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English

    • Preferably based out of Brazil.

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here . We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator
description:
Overview

Hiring: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator (Technical Operations Specialist)

Company: Copy Squad

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Location: Remote

Position Overview: Do you love building systems that make everything run smoother? Are you energized by automation, tech integrations, and streamlining workflows across multiple brands? Do you thrive behind the scenes, keeping operations tight while freeing up creative leaders to stay in their zone of genius? Then Copy Squad wants you on the team.

About The Company

We’re hiring a Remote Digital Operations Coordinator / Technical Operations Specialist to serve as an integrator across three brands, Copy Squad, PickJunkies, and our agency division. In this role, you’ll work directly with the CEO to build and maintain automations, streamline onboarding, organize creative assets, and analyze performance data. Your contributions will form the operational backbone of the business, enabling the creative team to stay focused on strategy and growth.

Copy Squad is a boutique agency that helps businesses scale through direct-response copywriting and strategic marketing. We specialize in high-converting funnels, email campaigns, and sales pages that deliver measurable results. Our culture values autonomy, clarity, and execution. We’re lean, agile, and driven by outcomes, not fluff.

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-savvy, proactive, and thrives on solving operational challenges. If you’re energized by creating systems, managing complexity, and turning ideas into action, you’ll fit right in.

Learn more about the company HERE.

Responsibilities

  • Build and manage automations in GoHighLevel (tags, triggers, email/SMS sequences, upsell/downsell flows)
  • Automate cross-sell and upsell campaigns (e.g., lifetime pass offers triggered post-purchase)
  • Integrate fulfillment extras (e.g., Printify t-shirt delivery) into automation stack
  • Maintain and optimize onboarding sequences from purchase → Discord → product access
  • Simplify onboarding for less tech-savvy users with walkthroughs and explainer videos
  • Maintain a centralized swipe file system for copywriters (Notion-based)
  • Organize and distribute high-performing promos, emails, and ads for easy access if requested by writers.
  • Use GoHighLevel API or integrations to track email performance (open/click rates)
  • Gather top-performing client promos and store them for internal use
  • Maintain templated assets for junior-level tasks (order forms, upsells, offers)
  • Ensure funnels (opt-ins, follow-ups, upsells) are running and optimized
  • Implement upsell triggers and fulfillment automation
  • Act as an ops partner across all brands, tying together tech, customer experience, and internal processes
  • Take over low-leverage tasks currently handled by the CEO and design lead
  • Focus first 30/60/90 days on agency swipe system, PickJunkies onboarding, and Copy Squad automations

Requirements

  • Exceptional fluency in English across reading, writing, and verbal communication
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in digital marketing or a similar agency environment (preferred)
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with automations, integrations, and system optimization
  • Minimum 2 years of project management experience using PM tools (e.g., ClickUp, Asana—not ticketing platforms)
  • Leadership experience in managing teams or cross-functional projects (preferred)
  • Familiarity with copywriting and marketing funnels (preferred)
  • Strong technical aptitude; comfortable working with automation platforms and digital tools
  • Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement long-term, scalable solutions
  • Skilled in breaking down complex projects into clear, actionable steps
  • Capable of making sound decisions independently and managing multiple priorities

Additional requirements

  • Available to work in U.S. EST time zones
  • Access to a computer and basic tech setup
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Reliable and distraction-free work environment
  • Financial industry knowledge is helpful
  • Project Management tool experience with Notion or similar software, highly preferred (Not ticketing tools like Jira)

This position is for a person who is

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong follow-through and task completion skills
  • Proactive self-starter who takes initiative without needing micromanagement
  • Operates with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Comfortable being direct and assertive, especially around deadlines
  • Professional and composed in fast-paced environments
  • Solution-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Takes ownership and avoids excuses
  • Motivated by impact and loves getting things done

This position is NOT for someone who

  • Struggles with follow-through or self-management
  • Has to be pushed to do their job
  • Prefers a slow-paced work environment
  • Lacks a sense of urgency
  • Thinks “good enough is good enough”
  • Makes excuses
  • Doesn’t care about getting exceptional results
  • Is unavailable to work during U.S. EST time zone
  • Can’t stand political conservative viewpoints
  • Hates the financial industry

Software Utilized by Company

GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Workspace, Printify

  • Full-time, remote, contractor position
  • BRL: R$6.720,00 - BRL: R$7.280,00/month
  • No benefits provided
  • We are professionals. We get the job done, done right, and done on time.
  • We deliver high-quality work.
  • We are efficient but not frenetic.
  • We use systems and processes to stay on task and finish on time.
  • We do not make excuses.

Interview Process

To better allow you to display your skills and to help us determine the best candidates, our recruiting process is approximately four to five weeks and takes place in four rounds:

  • Initial Application
  • Skills Application
  • Live interview with our recruiting agency
  • Final interview with CEO or manager

If selected, you will be invited by email to progress to the next round.

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

The Costa Rica FP&A Team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to support the Technology business, with all financial deliverables such as month end close responsibilities, cost forecasting, annual budget, regular monitoring of our performance metrics and other ad hoc analysis. Experian is a global company in data services, helping organizations and consumers manage risk and make informed decisions.   • Bachelor\'s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or other related discipline.

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in Finance at a team level, with expert skills in Excel.
  • Experience in commercial finance, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis, including financial models for forecasting and business scenario evaluation.
  • Skills in interpreting financial data from large datasets, verifying accuracy, and highlighting main insights, with experience in business intelligence tools and financial systems (Power BI, Tableau, Oracle, Hyperion preferred).

Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.

title: [Martech] Product Designer II
description:
Como é ser uma pessoa Product Designer:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é servir Canais Digitais, Marketing e Growth com tecnologia para alavancar o crescimento e a eficiência do funil de vendas. Somos um time de tecnologia responsável pelos sites das marcas do grupo (Stone, Ton e Pagar.me) — cuidando de CMS, infraestrutura e evolução contínua — e pelas ferramentas que suportam marketing e vendas, como Salesforce e Marketcloud. Trabalhamos para criar experiências digitais escaláveis, integradas e alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer, com foco em criação de interfaces e experiências digitais para plataformas web.
  • Capacidade de conduzir todo o processo de design, desde a pesquisa com usuários até a entrega de wireframes, protótipos e especificações.
  • Conhecimento em design systems e ferramentas como Figma, FigJam, entre outras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa, comunicando-se com as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e marketing para garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades do usuário e aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e entrega interativa.
  • Habilidade para conduzir testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento de usuários, garantindo que os designs sejam orientados por dados e feedback real.
  • Foco constante na experiência do usuário, sempre buscando simplificar e otimizar o design.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs ou no mercado financeiro.
  • Habilidade em design de interfaces para sistemas complexos e de grande escala.
  • Experiência com metodologias como Design Thinking e Lean UX.
  • Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar e defender as escolhas de design de forma clara e impactante.
  • Desejo de se atualizar constantemente sobre novas tendências e práticas no design de produtos.

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Mercor is seeking Brazilian Portuguese speakers who are also finance professionals based in Brazil. This role combines your financial analysis and investment expertise with language mastery , helping train cutting-edge AI models in the finance domain.

You will leverage your background in finance, alongside your bilingual communication skills, to create accurate, culturally nuanced, and technically precise content that reflects real-world finance usage in Portuguese.

Role Responsibilities

  • Financial Content Development: Translate, adapt, and synthesize complex financial concepts into clear, structured rubrics and documentation for AI training.
  • Bilingual Communication: Write fluently in both Portuguese and English, ensuring precise financial terminology and nuanced expression across languages.
  • Domain Expertise: Provide cultural and financial insights specific to Brazilian markets, regulations, and practices, ensuring linguistic and contextual accuracy in professional finance settings.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with reviewers and peers to refine content, validate accuracy, and align outputs with financial industry standards.

Ideal Candidates Should Have

  • Language Skills: Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese with strong written and spoken English.
  • Education: Advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2–6+ years of professional experience in finance, banking, consulting, investment, or related financial sectors.
  • Analytical Abilities: Excellent writing, analytical, and communication skills. Experience in financial writing, instructional design, reporting, or academic publishing is highly valued.

More Details About This Role

  • This is a remote and asynchronous role — work on your own schedule.
  • Expect to contribute at least 20 hours per week .
  • Expect a commitment of around 2 months.
  • You’ll be working in a structured project environment with clear goals and tools.

Application and Onboarding Process

  • Complete an AI-led interview to assess Portuguese language ability and professional experience. This should take around 15 minutes.
  • If selected, you’ll take a follow-up AI-led interview to assess your professional background.
  • You’ll then complete a paid work trial to determine if this type of work is suited for you.

We are hiring a Credit Manager to our Financial Solutions team in Brazil ! This is a Remote - Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

This role joins the Financial Solutions (Partners at Scale) team that is responsible for leading the credit department, with a primary focus on B2B operations. As the lead for the credit department, you'll be responsible for building and scaling the credit function from scratch. This is a hands-on role where you will define and implement credit policies and procedures, ensuring the financial health of business partnerships. The position involves conducting structured credit analyses for large clients, assessing financial statements and operational data to determine risk, and presenting cases to credit committees.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We are an AI technology solutions provider for major technology companies and diverse industries including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies with a global workforce of subject matter experts and a high-security infrastructure, we offer digital data solutions and high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical Diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description—we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
